bandReport.notes:
Q33-50, 18 items, all complete within p05-p08. Two-column layout: LEFT column top-to-bottom, then RIGHT. p05 = Q33-35 left, Q36-38 right. p06 = Q39-40 left, Q41-42 right. p07 = Q43-44 left, Q45-46 right. p08 = Q47-48 left, Q49-50 right.

STRUCTURE: this band is ENTIRELY Directions sets — nine consecutive 'Consider the following for the next two (02) items that follow :' blocks, every one of them a 2-item set, and every one STARTING inside my pages. There is not a single standalone question in Q33-50. Sets: D33-34, D35-36, D37-38, D39-40, D41-42, D43-44, D45-46, D47-48, D49-50.

SEAM BEFORE (p04, opened not transcribed): p04 carries Q28-32. It has a 2-item Directions block (flagstaff on a tower) that STARTS on p04 and whose members Q31 and Q32 both sit on p04 — that set is complete on p04 and belongs to the band owning p04, not to me. Nothing on p04 spills into p05: the last item there (Q32) has all four options printed on p04, and p05 opens with a fresh Directions block. No set starting before p05 has any member inside p05.

SEAM AFTER (p09, opened not transcribed): p09 opens at Q51 with standalone questions (Q51-57 visible), no continuation of anything from p08 and no Directions block carried over. Q50 is complete on p08 with all four options printed. Clean seam both ways.

FIGURES: ZERO. No printed diagram anywhere on p05-p08 — no geometry figure, no chart, no number line. Q35-36 (two parallel chords), Q39-40 (conical cap over two spheres) and Q41-42 (semi-circles on AB, AC, CB with an inscribed circle) are all configurations described entirely in words with no accompanying figure on the page; nothing is left unanswerable by the absence of one, so no hasFigure/figureNote is set on any item.

TABLES: ONE. Q47-48 share a printed grouped-frequency table (weekly wages vs numbers of workers, 6 class intervals, one frequency given as the unknown k). Transcribed as a GFM pipe table with separator row inside `context`, identical on both members. The class-interval dashes are printed as en dashes; written as plain hyphens.

CURRENCY: the booklet prints the rupee glyph in Q45 options, Q46 options, the Q47 stem, the Q48 options and the Q47-48 table header. Written as 'Rs.' per the brief's currency rule, matching the convention already used across the 2020-1/2020-2/2024-1 band files; no LaTeX macro invented.

DECIMALS: none occur in this band — no raised middle dot appears anywhere on p05-p08.

HIGH-ZOOM CROPS (6-8x from the source PDF, because the character decides the item): Q38's expression \(x^2(px^2 + qy^2 + rz^2) + qr - p^2\); Q39's four options (r vs R inside each numerator); Q43's fraction \(\frac{x^2+ab}{x^2+m^2ab}\); Q44's four options (the vinculum extent — confirmed the radical covers all of 'mab', 'ab', '2mab', '2ab' rather than only the leading letter); the Q49-50 quadratic \((a+b+c)x^2-(2a+2b)x+(a+b-c)=0\); Q49's four options (the sign pattern inside each numerator, and the leading root being 1 in (a),(b) versus -1 in (c),(d)); the Q47-48 frequency table; Q47's Rs. 3,520; Q48's four amounts. All read as transcribed.

DO NOT 'REPAIR' Q39/Q40 — their options A and B are correct as transcribed. Option A is \(\frac{2r^2}{R-r}\) with a LOWERCASE r; option B is \(\frac{2R^2}{R-r}\) with an UPPERCASE R, and the shared context defines r as the radius of the smaller sphere and R as the radius of the bigger sphere, so the case distinction IS the content of the item. Re-verified at 9x from the source PDF for both questions: the (a) numerator carries the short baseline r, the (b) numerator the tall bowl-and-leg R, unambiguously. Recorded because an earlier revision of check-bands.ts lowercased option text before its duplicate comparison and therefore reported A and B as identical on both items (it flagged Q31 of band b1, 'H tan y - h tan B' vs 'h tan y - H tan B', for the same reason). That check has since been made case-SENSITIVE and the paper now runs clean, so this paragraph is history rather than a live finding — it is kept only so that nobody meeting a similar r/R, h/H or x/X option pair in this corpus concludes the transcription is at fault.

MISPRINTS: none found. Nothing on these four pages is ambiguous or self-contradictory after the crops above; no flags entry was needed on any of the 18 items.

UNREADABLE: nothing.

INVENTED SUBTOPICS: none — every (chapter, subtopic) pair used is listed in catalog.json.

CLASSIFICATION NOTE (not a defect, recorded so the reader knows it was a judgement rather than an oversight): the two members of D41-42 are filed under DIFFERENT chapters. Q41 asks for a radius relation between two touching circles (Circles / Two Circles and Common Tangents); Q42 converts the same configuration into an area comparison (Mensuration 2D / Inscribed and Circumscribed Figures). Their shared `context` is byte-identical, so the set still groups correctly.
